description: This file defines a base class for membership table tests in Orleans, including constants, setup, and utility methods for testing membership table operations such as insert, update, read, and cleanup. It is part of the test suite for Orleans membership management.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableTestConstants
classes.description: Contains constants used in membership table tests, such as timeouts and status strings.

classes.name: MembershipTableTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common setup, utility methods, and test scenarios for Orleans membership table testing.

methods.name: MembershipTable_GetGateways
methods.description: Test method to verify reading all membership entries and gateway list behavior.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method to verify reading from an empty membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_InsertRow
methods.description: Test method to verify inserting a row into the membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method to verify reading, inserting, and re-reading a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method to verify reading all, inserting, and re-reading all membership data.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method to verify updating a membership row with optimistic concurrency.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method to verify concurrent updates to the same membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method to verify updating the IAmAlive timestamp of a membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTable_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test method to verify cleanup of defunct (dead or non-active) silo entries.

methods.name: CreateMembershipEntryForTest
methods.description: Utility method to create a test membership entry.

methods.name: GetUtcNowWithSecondsResolution
methods.description: Utility method to get current UTC time with seconds resolution.

methods.name: CreateSiloAddressForTest
methods.description: Utility method to create a test silo address.
